Original SVG image-mask controls, generated by tools/svg_image_masks_fixture.py.

Native PNGs from the reference application, extracted with capture-svg-group-raster.ps1 and record_svg_masks.py. These are original authored artwork; no third-party document or font is included. Source, native metafile and PNG hashes are retained in metafile-reference.json.

Cases 1–2 are vector controls (opaque and nearly opaque white ellipses). Cases 3–6 use PNG/JPEG luminance masks, with and without an sRGB inversion filter. The scaled fixture retains eight-times-larger source images. The ordinary fixture resamples those images before embedding. Image masks match native alpha exactly at 1:1; scaled image masks and the vector controls remain unresolved.
